structured.answer: I'd open an account at פסגות and buy the "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)" fund. The page marks it "הזול ביותר לתוכנית שלכם" and shows 86,492 ₪ after 10 years from 70,000 ₪ put in, vs 84,184 ₪ for the default.

stuck.where: Long fund list and account list (screens 1-3)
stuck.why: Every row repeats the same coloured tags, so I had to re-read them each time to find the difference; I got tired and stopped reading the rows.

stuck.where: Cost bars 'כמה זה עולה לכם ב־10 שנים'
stuck.why: The numbers sit in coloured pieces but what each colour means is in a legend row below, so I had to look back and forth.
84,184 from 70,000 over 10 years at 7% felt low compared with what I expected; I wasn't sure if I misread.

used: Heading 'איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד, לאורך זמן'
Link 'לעבור אל ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D), פסגות'
skimmed: Fund list 'כל הקרנות על מדד S&P 500'
'מתחילים מבחירה אחת, ורואים מה משפר אותו ובכמה'
Legend row under the cost bars
skipped: 'מה הכי משנה את מה שיישאר לכם' chart and table
'עם נטרול מט״ח או בלי: מה קרה בפועל' charts and table
Explanation text under the fund list
unsure_meaning: -533 ₪ / -536 ₪ next to funds (read as losing money)
Which colour in the cost bars is what, without the legend
not_found: A plain 'first step: do this' instruction
My own amounts (30,000 ₪) — I didn't change the sliders
Whether the 86,492 holds if the dollar moves

findings.what: Every fund row repeats the same set of coloured tags, so you re-read them on each row to find the difference
findings.where: Fund list and account list, screens 1-3

findings.what: Numbers sit on coloured bar pieces but the colour meanings are in a separate legend row; I had to match them back and forth
findings.where: 'כמה זה עולה לכם ב־10 שנים' bars

findings.what: Negative shekel numbers like -533 ₪ next to funds look like a loss and scare me off
Lots of jargon tags I don't understand (צוברת, מנוטרלת מט״ח, 4D)
Default choice is a brand I don't know (אינטראקטיב ישראל / MEXEM) instead of the cheapest familiar one
Page is very long; past the top box everything felt like extra
